name: skillmama-cli
description: CLI for the skillmama package. `skillmama scan [dir]` produces a structured StackProfile; `skillmama check <package>` runs the live-data half of the pipeline (OSV advisories, npm publisher continuity, Popularity/Maintenance bands) against a published package.

scripts.test: npm run build && node --test test/render.test.js test/check.test.js test/e2e.test.js
